title: Fix: O(n²) freeze in enrichDiffWithRenames — size gates, early exits, pre-filtered Levenshtein candidates

done: Root cause identified: enrichDiffWithRenames lines 182-191 and 229-240 iterate ALL bKeys per removed entry, calling matchScore + levenshtein on each — O(removes × allKeys)

notes: FUZZY_SIZE_LIMIT=5000 only gates whether fuzzy runs at all, not the cost within it
rename loop (diff-algorithm.ts:182-191): worst case 200 removed × 5000 keys = 1M levenshtein calls
move loop (diff-algorithm.ts:229-240): same pattern for move detection
Fix 1: lower limits + removed-count early exit (S01, S02, S03)
Fix 2: pre-filter with isRelated() before matchScore so Levenshtein only runs on related candidates (S04)
Fix 3: propagate AbortSignal into worker for mid-run cancellation (S07)
Exact rename/move (by serialized value index) always runs regardless of limits

steps.description: Tighten size gates and add removed-count early exit in enrichDiffWithRenames. Changes in src/core/domain/diff-algorithm.ts: (1) FUZZY_SIZE_LIMIT 5000→500. (2) Add FUZZY_MOVE_SIZE_LIMIT=200 (same as FUZZY_SIZE_LIMIT — moves are rarer). (3) Add REMOVED_SIZE_SKIP=100 — compute removed count from structural before entering fuzzy loops; if >100, skip both fuzzy passes entirely (exact rename/move still runs). (4) Apply bKeys.length <= FUZZY_MOVE_SIZE_LIMIT gate to the move fuzzy loop. Sync updated file to src/lib/domain/diff-algorithm.js via bun run sync:lib.
steps.done_condition: FUZZY_SIZE_LIMIT=500, FUZZY_MOVE_SIZE_LIMIT=200, REMOVED_SIZE_SKIP=100 in diff-algorithm.ts; all size-limit constants documented; sync:lib succeeds; bun run typecheck clean

steps.description: Pre-filter Levenshtein candidates in enrichDiffWithRenames. Changes in src/core/domain/diff-algorithm.ts: (1) Rename fuzzy loop: iterate fbOnly keys (not all bKeys), call isRelated() first, only call matchScore if isRelated passes. (2) Move fuzzy loop: same — iterate fbOnly, call isRelated() first, then matchScore. This reduces worst case from removes×allKeys to removes×relatedCandidates (typically much smaller). Sync to src/lib/domain/diff-algorithm.js via bun run sync:lib.
steps.done_condition: Both fuzzy loops iterate only fbOnly keys; isRelated() called before matchScore in both loops; sync:lib succeeds; bun run typecheck clean

steps.description: Propagate AbortSignal into diff-worker for mid-run cancellation. Changes: (1) src/hooks/use-diff-worker.js: add runDiff accepts optional {signal} options; pass signal.aborted flag in postMessage. (2) src/workers/diff-worker.js: read signal from e.data.signal; add isAborted() helper; check at top of fuzzy loops; if aborted post {type:'cancelled',id} and return early; do NOT post further messages. (3) src/pages/DiffViewer.jsx: wire existing cancel() mechanism to the signal-aware runDiff call (use AbortController in the compare handler).
steps.done_condition: Worker checks signal.aborted in both fuzzy loops; posts 'cancelled' message and returns early when set; clicking Reset mid-run produces no stale results, no console errors

steps.description: Add unit tests for size-limit behavior and pre-filtered candidate pool. (1) Test: spec with >500 keys total → fuzzy rename/move skipped (removed stays as 'removed'). (2) Test: spec with 200 removed, 400 total keys → fuzzy skipped (removed stays). (3) Test: spec with 20 removed, 400 total keys → fuzzy runs and finds renames. (4) Test: empty specs return []. (5) Verify exact rename detection still works regardless of size limits. Run: bun test src/core/domain/diff-algorithm.test.ts (create if missing), bun test src/core/domain/levenshtein.test.ts. bun run typecheck && bun run lint clean.
steps.done_condition: bun test src/core/domain/ — all pass; bun run typecheck clean; bun run lint clean

mergeOrder: step-1 → step-2 (both domain, sequential to ensure size gates exist before pre-filter uses them)

riskRegister.risk: Lowering FUZZY_SIZE_LIMIT from 5000→500 breaks fuzzy rename detection on mid-size specs that legitimately benefit from it
riskRegister.mitigation: Exact rename/move (by value index) always runs regardless of size; fuzzy is a bonus. Users with >500-key specs still get exact-match rename detection.

riskRegister.risk: Pre-filter with isRelated() might exclude valid fuzzy candidates (fields moved across unrelated subtrees)
riskRegister.mitigation: isRelated allows up to 40% depth divergence which is generous for API field renames. Can be relaxed later if needed.

riskRegister.risk: AbortSignal propagation adds complexity to the worker contract
riskRegister.mitigation: Check is a 2-line guard at loop top; does not change the message protocol for non-cancelled runs.

successCriteria: A spec pair with 200 removed fields and 500 total keys completes enrichDiffWithRenames in <1s with no UI freeze
Exact rename detection still works on specs of any size
Worker can be cancelled mid-computation with no stale results and no console errors
bun test passes for all diff-algorithm and levenshtein tests
completion_evidence: Shipped in commits 66e2d53 (eliminate O(n²) freeze in enrichDiffWithRenames), 6d1885d (size-guard + isRelated pre-filter), 3bb53e1 (hotfix with FUZZY_SIZE_LIMIT guard). Reconciled from in_progress → done.
